description: Look up an IPv4 or IPv6 address: country, continent and origin ASN/operator. Paid plans automatically include supported approximate city/state, state name, postal code, latitude/longitude, timezone, routed network, ASN category and datacenter/relay/Tor/VPN/proxy flags. Unknown location values are null. ASN category is not subscriber connection technology; proxy/VPN false means unlisted.

deep.description: Legacy profile request flag. API 2.1 paid plans include profile detail automatically. Existing access rules and explicit metered operations remain unchanged.

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.
